task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The two plans compare a shared student room for two people and a single room at an Australian university, which cost 350 and 200 dollars a week respectively.

Overall, the rooms are laid out in a very similar way, with the same basic facilities in the same positions; the shared room is simply deeper, better furnished and almost twice as expensive.

Both rooms are six metres wide and have a bathroom in the left-hand corner, a small kitchen area with a sink and stove along the left wall, a study desk against the top wall and a bed beside the window at the far end. The single room, however, is only 2.5 metres deep and contains just one bed, one desk, a microwave and a television, making it a fairly compact space for one occupant.

The double room, at four metres deep, offers considerably more space and furniture. It accommodates two beds and two study desks, one placed near the window and the other towards the bottom of the room, and the extra depth leaves space for a table and chairs in the centre where the occupants can eat or socialise, as well as a bookshelf and cupboard between the beds. Students therefore pay 150 dollars a week more for the shared room, but each occupant effectively pays less than in the single room — 175 dollars as opposed to 200.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Ikkita reja Avstraliya universitetidagi ikki kishilik umumiy talaba xonasi va bir kishilik xonani solishtiradi — ular haftasiga mos ravishda 350 va 200 dollar turadi.

Umuman olganda, xonalar juda o'xshash tarzda joylashtirilgan bo'lib, bir xil asosiy qulayliklar bir xil o'rinlarda; umumiy xona shunchaki chuqurroq, yaxshiroq jihozlangan va deyarli ikki baravar qimmat.

Har ikkala xona ham olti metr kenglikda bo'lib, chap burchakda hammom, chap devor bo'ylab yuvish moslamasi va plitali kichik oshxona maydoni, yuqori devor yonida yozuv stoli va narigi chekkadagi deraza yonida karavot bor. Biroq bir kishilik xona atigi 2,5 metr chuqurlikda va unda faqat bitta karavot, bitta stol, mikroto'lqinli pech va televizor mavjud — bu bir kishi uchun ancha ixcham makon.

To'rt metr chuqurlikdagi ikki kishilik xona esa ancha ko'proq joy va jihoz taklif etadi. U ikkita karavot va ikkita yozuv stolini sig'diradi — biri deraza yonida, ikkinchisi xonaning pastki qismida — qo'shimcha chuqurlik esa o'rtada yashovchilar ovqatlanishi yoki suhbatlashishi mumkin bo'lgan stol-stullar hamda karavotlar orasidagi kitob javoni va shkaf uchun joy qoldiradi. Shunday qilib, talabalar umumiy xona uchun haftasiga 150 dollar ko'proq to'laydi, biroq har bir yashovchiga bu bir kishilik xonadagidan arzonroq tushadi — 200 dollar o'rniga 175 dollar.

task2.title: Will technology reduce crime?
task2.prompt: Crime rates are likely to decline due to advancements in technology, which will help prevent and solve crimes more easily. Do you agree or disagree?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
It is often claimed that crime rates will fall as technology advances, because new tools make offences easier to prevent and to solve. I largely agree with this view, although I believe technology simultaneously creates new forms of crime that offset part of the gain.

On the prevention side, the evidence is persuasive. Surveillance cameras, alarm systems and smart locks make burglary and street crime far riskier than a generation ago, and their mere presence acts as a deterrent. Everyday technology protects people too: cars with immobilisers are rarely stolen, contactless payments reduce the cash that once attracted robbers, and phones allow any witness to call the police or record evidence instantly.

Technology has transformed detection just as profoundly. DNA analysis, fingerprint databases and CCTV footage now solve cases that would once have gone unpunished, while data analysis helps police predict where offences are likely and deploy officers accordingly. Because the chance of being caught is the strongest influence on a would-be criminal, better detection itself prevents crime. Nevertheless, the picture is not entirely positive: criminal activity has partly migrated online, where fraud, hacking and identity theft flourish and enforcement is difficult, and criminals adopt new tools as quickly as the police do. This is why I agree only with reservations.

In conclusion, I agree that technology is likely to push traditional crime rates down, since it makes offences harder to commit and far easier to solve. However, governments must invest just as heavily in fighting cybercrime, otherwise crime will not so much decline as change its shape.
task2.uzSampleBand8:
Texnologiya rivojlangani sari jinoyatchilik darajasi pasayadi, chunki yangi vositalar jinoyatlarning oldini olish va ochishni osonlashtiradi, deb tez-tez aytiladi. Men bu fikrga asosan qo'shilaman, garchi texnologiya ayni paytda yutuqning bir qismini yo'qqa chiqaradigan yangi jinoyat turlarini ham yaratadi deb hisoblasam-da.

Oldini olish borasida dalillar ishonarli. Kuzatuv kameralari, signalizatsiya tizimlari va aqlli qulflar uy o'g'riligi va ko'cha jinoyatlarini bir avlod avvalgiga qaraganda ancha xatarli qilib qo'ydi, ularning shunchaki mavjudligi esa to'xtatuvchi omil bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Kundalik texnologiya ham odamlarni himoya qiladi: immobilayzerli mashinalar kamdan-kam o'g'irlanadi, kontaktsiz to'lovlar bir paytlar bosqinchilarni o'ziga tortgan naqd pulni kamaytiradi, telefonlar esa istalgan guvohga bir zumda politsiyani chaqirish yoki dalilni yozib olish imkonini beradi.

Texnologiya jinoyatlarni ochishni ham xuddi shunday tubdan o'zgartirdi. DNK tahlili, barmoq izlari bazalari va videokuzatuv yozuvlari ilgari jazosiz qolib ketadigan ishlarni endi ochmoqda, ma'lumotlar tahlili esa politsiyaga jinoyatlar qayerda ehtimolliroq ekanini bashorat qilib, xodimlarni shunga qarab joylashtirishga yordam beradi. Bo'lajak jinoyatchiga eng kuchli ta'sir qiluvchi omil — qo'lga tushish ehtimoli bo'lgani uchun, yaxshiroq ochishning o'zi jinoyatning oldini oladi. Shunga qaramay, manzara to'liq ijobiy emas: jinoiy faoliyat qisman internetga ko'chdi — u yerda firibgarlik, xakerlik va shaxsni o'g'irlash avj olgan, qonunni qo'llash esa qiyin — jinoyatchilar ham yangi vositalarni politsiya bilan teng tezlikda o'zlashtiradi. Shu bois men faqat ayrim izohlar bilan qo'shilaman.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya an'anaviy jinoyatchilik darajasini pasaytirishi ehtimoliga qo'shilaman, chunki u jinoyat sodir etishni qiyinlashtirib, ochishni ancha osonlashtiradi. Biroq hukumatlar kiberjinoyatchilikka qarshi kurashga ham xuddi shunday jiddiy sarmoya kiritishi kerak, aks holda jinoyatchilik kamaymaydi, balki shaklini o'zgartiradi, xolos.
